comment: Single source of truth for the completion-outbox health observer the worker and CLI share (#2422). The worker snapshots Valkey (`apps/worker/src/curie_worker/completion_health.py`) and emits bounded gauges; cluster status and doctor kubectl-exec the same `--json` reader inside a worker pod. The two lanes cannot share code across Python/Rust, so the literals are frozen here. Changing one language without this file fails that language's test. Read by apps/worker/tests/test_completion_outbox_vector.py and the test module in cli/src/completion_outbox.rs. An unknown top-level key is rejected so a new key one lane cannot see cannot pass vacuously.
